title: Weight-Space Programming for Improving Image-Restoration Diffusion Models: Technical Conjectures and a Recursive Improvement Loop
metadata_mismatch: none (second author listed as 'Doubao' in both paper and metadata; only one email given)
why_wsp: Position paper proposing (not running) an LLM that reads layer statistics of a diffusion restoration UNet and proposes sparse weight deltas, accepted by a PSNR-gated sandbox, in a diagnose-edit-evaluate loop.
domain: image restoration diffusion models (deblurring, super-resolution, denoising, inpainting)
editor: unspecified frontier LLM ('GPT-6-class' mentioned in Sec. 5); no experiments run
target: diffusion restoration UNet (generic; '100M-parameter UNet' mentioned in Limitations); none actually edited
interface: other (proposed: chunked layer statistics in, JSON edit proposal {layer, slice, delta} out; pseudocode only)
self_editing: no; LLM edits a separate UNet. Authors call the loop 'a minimal recursive self-improvement (RSI) loop' but the editor is not the target.
fraction_or_count_of_weights_changed: Proposed cap only: 'Edit-ratio cap: < 0.1% of total parameters modified cumulatively.' (Sec. 6.1). No measured edit.

headline_results.claim: No empirical results; all numbers are conjectured targets
headline_results.quote: The numerical conjectures in this manuscript are merely hypotheses.

headline_results.claim: Conjectured gains (C2 +0.2-0.5 dB, C3 +0.5-1.5 dB total), stated as expectations not measurements
headline_results.quote: C2: Sparse edit Improve quality via weight delta +0.2–0.5 dB PSNR
If the LLM cannot improve PSNR by ≥ 0.2 dB on at least half of the concentrated-defect benchmark cases, with < 0.1% parameters edited, C2 is false.

cost.quote: Forward-pass budget: 30–50 total evaluations per WSP session.

baselines_and_controls: none run; qualitative comparison table vs LoRA and full fine-tuning (Table 3); proposed benchmark uses distributed defects as negative controls (Sec. 9.3)
runs_and_variance: single run / not reported (no experiments); notes diffusion seed noise would require averaging, 'only 2–3 seeds per evaluation' under a 40-pass budget (Sec. 7)
robustness_of_edits: not tested; Limitations flag OOD side effects: 'An edit that helps the feedback set may hurt out-of-distribution images.'
memorization_vs_reasoning: Asserts without evidence that diagnosis/editing is 'pattern-matching + reasoning, not superintelligence' (Sec. 5).
limitations_stated: Model too large for LLM context (works on summaries); distributed defects not fixable by sparse edits; channel permutation symmetry; OOD side effects; LLM bias toward late layers.
code_or_data: none found (PyTorch-style pseudocode in Listings 1-2 only)
notes_for_survey: Purely conjectural position paper with falsifiable criteria and a sandbox/loop design but no experiments. Proposes a concentrated-vs-distributed defect taxonomy (Table 1) predicting which restoration failures are sparsely editable. Second listed author is 'Doubao' (an LLM product name).
